definitions.explanation: the formal process of deciding on a matter through voting, especially in legislative contexts

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採決|さいけつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A vote was taken on the bill.

examples.japanese: {採決|さいけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{賛成|さんせい}{多数|たすう}→賛成多数：09759_sanseitasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the vote, it was passed by a majority in favor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{採決|さいけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}した→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧。
examples.english: The chairman announced that a vote would be taken.

notes:
FORMS:
{採|さい} (pick, adopt) + {決|けつ} (decide) → deciding by picking/voting
{採決|さいけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a vote, to put to a vote)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採決|さいけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a vote)
- {採決|さいけつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付|ふ}す (to put to a vote)
- ⟦{強行|きょうこう}→強行：12559_kyoukou⟧{採決|さいけつ} (railroading a vote through)

OUTCOMES:
- ⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧ (passage, approval)
- ⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧ (rejection)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧ (ballot, general voting)
- ⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧ (resolution)
